name: r3_statkit
summary: HELD-OUT validation target (not used to tune any fix): a small numeric/stats package (aggregate/window/parse/dedup/format) with 5 verified planted bugs + 2 distractors. Different domain from r1/r2.
review_task: Review the `statkit` package in this directory for bugs and correctness issues. Look across ALL modules. For each issue, give the file and a one-line description. Be precise: only report genuine issues.

issues.desc: mean() uses integer division // so it truncates; mean([1,2]) returns 1 instead of 1.5.
running_total uses mutable default acc=[] so state leaks across calls (accumulates globally).
sliding_mean off-by-one: range(len(xs)-size) drops the last window; should be len(xs)-size+1.
unique uses list(set(items)) which does not preserve first-seen order (order is part of the contract).
parse_ints crashes with ValueError on an empty/trailing field (e.g. '1,2,') because int('') fails.

distractors.desc: unique_stable correctly preserves first-seen order — NOT a bug (it's the correct counterpart to unique).
percent uses round(fraction*100, digits) — correct, NOT a bug.
